asymptotics.note: exponential approach: a generator materially below P_min long after ON entry still hard-fails; no fixed grace window exists

discrete_replay_adjudication.available_evidence: 1 Hz plant_trajectory_v1 state_DG*/P_DG* signals; the 0.01 s native audit records only VIOLATION events, not state transitions
discrete_replay_adjudication.conservative_rule: adjudicate with dt_lower = max(0, dt_hat - 1); P_floor is monotone increasing so the lower-dt floor is more permissive -> no false HARD failures from timing quantization
discrete_replay_adjudication.on_entry_estimation: t_ON_hat = first 1 Hz sample with state == 3; true entry lies in the preceding 1 s interval
discrete_replay_adjudication.resolution_claim: 1 Hz, NOT 0.01 s; uncertainty bounded and documented (band < epsilon region beyond ~26 s)

envelope_definition.legality_rule: ON state admissible iff P_actual(dt) >= P_floor(dt) - epsilon_numeric
piecewise: 0 <= dt <= t_r : P_floor(dt) = r*[dt - tau*(1 - exp(-dt/tau))]
dt > t_r      : P_floor(dt) = P_min + (P_r - P_min)*exp(-(dt - t_r)/tau)
envelope_definition.rationale: P_cmd >= P_min is guaranteed by the plant's own clamp; the minimum-command response is therefore the lower bound of every legal loading trajectory

epsilon_numeric.derivation: half-sample slew quantization r*dt/2 = 0.10 kW + Euler global truncation bound r*dt^2*(t_r+5*tau)/(2*tau^2) = 0.00625 kW, rounded up; INDEPENDENT of epoch-2 outcome distributions
epsilon_numeric.empirical_cross_check: source-exact discrete simulation (cmd=P_min, 0.01 s Euler, 60 s) vs closed form: max |sim - floor| = 0.107 kW <= 0.11 kW

required: P_unserved energy (native 0.01 s integral embedded in terminal records)

source_semantics.chain: ON-state: P_ref_c = clamp(P_ref, P_min, rated); P_ramp slew-limited at r; P_lag Euler update P_lag += (P_ramp - P_lag)*dt/tau with dt = 0.01 s
source_semantics.on_meaning: SYNC->ON fires at sync-dwell completion with P_ramp = P_lag = 0; loading happens INSIDE ON; below-Pmin during loading is the model's registered transition
